name: Historic Monuments Zone of Querétaro
description: In central Mexico, about 213 km northwest of Mexico City, Querétaro's old town mixes two layouts: a tidy grid planned by the Spanish and tangled lanes left from the Indigenous quarters. Otomi, Tarasco, Chichimeca and Spanish residents shared the town. Wandering between them, you pass the richly decorated Baroque churches and mansions built in its 17th- and 18th-century heyday.
